_doc: Buying rounds (#22, owner 2026-11-21: "I will not be able to buy all the parts at once"). Each stage issue (#7-#15) is in exactly one round; a row's stage puts it in a round. Rounds follow the build: each one lets the next stage start. Edit and run python3 bom/totals.py --rounds --write-page.

rounds.name: Frame
rounds.why: The frame, its fasteners and the filament: printing parts and building the frame can start. The extrusion order waits on #243 (gantry height).

rounds.name: Motion
rounds.why: Z axis, bed and gantry on the frame: everything that moves, before anything drives it.

rounds.name: Electronics
rounds.why: Boards, supplies and wiring: the axes can be homed and tested with no toolhead fitted.

rounds.name: Toolheads
rounds.why: The toolchanger and the heads. Per-head rows are costed for every head; one head's worth is largely owned already.

rounds.name: Enclosure and calibration
rounds.why: Panels, doors, roof, chamber fans and heater, then first power-on and calibration: the printer prints before it's closed in.
